tournament.name: December OCC Clash Qualifier
tournament.description:
OCC CLASH DECEMBER SCHEDULE:


Qualifier Brackets - December 9 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline December 9 @ 1200 GMT)

            - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season.


Round of 8 Finals - December 16 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline December 14 @ 2300 GMT)

          -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 6 qualified  players being positioned in #3 to #8.
